title: Changelog visual asset suite — hero banners, annotated diffs, localized screenshots
creator: Ava Chen
description: Produce a consolidated image pack for the March changelog + short blog post: hero banner, three feature callout panels, five before/after diffshots (UI state A -> UI state B), localized screenshot sets (en, fr, de, ja), plus small social tiles and an alt-text CSV. Assets should be ready-to-drop into the marketing site and product docs. Deliverables include source Figma file, export-ready PNG/SVG/WebP files, and a Drive folder with naming conventions and alt-text. Work must coordinate with PM (feature copy) and ENG for final UI renders and feature flags.
acceptance_criteria: Hero banner 1200x628 exported in PNG and WebP with 2x retina variants
Three feature callout panels at 1280x720, each with annotated arrows and short caption overlays
Five before/after diffshots with consistent device mockup and overlay highlighting changed elements
Localized screenshots exported for en, fr, de, ja with translated captions and correct date formatting
Alt-text CSV mapping filenames to 1-line and 2-line descriptions for accessibility and SEO
File naming and folder structure documented in Drive and referenced in PRD
Design handoff completed with assets linked in PR and Console docs (link in comments)
tasks: Sync with PM to lock copy and feature priority
Capture latest UI from ENG (staging builds) for accurate diffshots
Design hero banner and 3 callout panels, iterate with PM and Growth
Create before/after diff templates and apply to each feature change
Localize captions and run QA for text truncation in all target languages
Export assets per naming spec and verify accessible alt-text
Upload final package to Drive and link in PRD + blog draft

design_decisions: Use a consistent device mockup (13" laptop frame) for all diffshots to reduce visual noise and make differences legible.
Callouts will use a single highlight color derived from Redwood brand palette (#0066FF) to tie to product messaging and ensure contrast.
Export both opaque caption overlays and caption-free variants so marketing can reuse assets on different backgrounds.
Avoid micro-animations in the primary changelog package to keep file size small; provide one GIF variant for social preview only.
export_spec: Hero: 1200x628 PNG (web), 2400x1256 PNG (retina), SVG source, WebP fallback
Callout panels: 1280x720 PNG, 640x360 mobile crop, caption overlay 40px sans-serif at 2x
Diffshots: 1100x700 PNG with shadowed device mockup, overlay arrows as SVG exported separately
Social tiles: 800x800 PNG and 1200x600 landscape variant
Alt-text CSV: filename, 1-line alt, 2-line descriptive alt
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: UI from staging may change before publish. Mitigation: request final screenshot freeze from ENG and capture both flagged states.
Risk: Translated text may overflow. Mitigation: tighten copy and provide expanded artboards with 10% padding for long locales.
Risk: Contrast failure on callout overlays. Mitigation: run automatic contrast checks and provide two overlay opacity levels.
post_release_notes: Upload final alt-text CSV to content repo and tag marketing for SEO metadata addition.
Create a mini-gallery in Console docs showing before/after with captions and linked GitHub PR for engineering context.
Run a quick analytics check on social tiles CTR after publication and iterate if underperforming.
